revision_candidate.test_name: Run MLPerf Inference v5.0 ResNet-50 Server
revision_candidate.purpose: Execute the approved MLPerf Inference v5.0 ResNet-50 Server configuration, verify ImageNet classification accuracy plus LoadGen/compliance validity, measure latency-valid Server queries per second, and compare only with a signed comparable v5.0 result.
revision_candidate.applicable_platform_environment: Exact SUT/GPU topology, driver/runtime, v5.0 inference container/harness, ResNet-50 model, ImageNet data/preprocessing and configs.
revision_candidate.target_scope: ResNet-50 Server only across declared resources. BERT, RetinaNet, Offline and MLPerf Training are excluded. 240/60 minutes are planning values unless mapped by the approved harness.
revision_candidate.required_inputs: Corrected source; pinned stack; licensed model/ImageNet/preprocessing hashes; configs; accuracy/performance/compliance commands; Server QPS/latency rules; comparable result ID; tuning/health/recovery limits.
revision_candidate.test_command_procedure_intent: Verify hashes/configs and baseline health, then run ResNet-50 accuracy, Server performance and required compliance using the pinned v5.0 inference implementation. Preserve ImageNet preprocessing, full LoadGen latency-validity logs and telemetry; do not use training_results or BERT.
revision_candidate.preconditions: Conflicts corrected; artifacts licensed/pinned; GPUs healthy; resources/tuning/load/recovery approved.
revision_candidate.expected_evidence: System/GPU identity; artifact/config/preprocessing hashes; exact commands; ResNet-50 accuracy; complete LoadGen Server QPS/latency validity; compliance; GPU/host telemetry; named reference/normalized comparison; final health.
revision_candidate.acceptance_reference: Signed v5.0 ResNet-50 Server rules and comparable result. Pass requires classification accuracy, LoadGen/compliance and Server latency validity, numeric QPS comparison and clean health.
revision_candidate.safety_restrictions: Do not mix training/inference, models/scenarios/releases, use unlicensed ImageNet, alter preprocessing/tuning without approval, clear logs, suppress invalidity or claim official status.
revision_candidate.human_approval_requirements: Benchmark/data/platform owners approve artifacts/reference/load; human judges result.
revision_candidate.manual_boundaries: Humans correct source/reference; Agent runs frozen inference profile only.
revision_candidate.recovery_requirements: Stop on invalidity/limits, preserve evidence, terminate cleanly, restore state and verify health.
revision_candidate.stop_conditions: Conflicts or reference unresolved; wrong model/scenario/release; missing license/config; accuracy/LoadGen/compliance failure; topology/XID/ECC/thermal/power/storage/host limit; evidence loss.
